tier_reason: C stands: implementer's own numbers, seen through search snippets only; no independent measurement found.

corrections.caveats: Enricher: if the Qt Creator percentages (22.09/37.28/30.66%) are time saved, they correspond to about 1.28x/1.59x/1.44x (derived). LLVM's HandleLLVMOptions.cmake turns PCH off by default with GCC (GCC 14/15 gave very little gain and a bigger build directory), with sccache, and with ccache on non-Clang compilers (stale objects when only a macro changes). CMake marks the PCH as a system header, hiding its warnings. llvm-project issue 61750: mlpack's PCH takes 190 s and 7.8 GB to build, an empty main() 90 s and 4.1 GB. An LLVM RFC claim of 1.5-2x was seen only as a snippet.

tier_reason: C to B: independent public scripts (j-jorge/unity-build) measure CMAKE_UNITY_BUILD on three projects with the CPU stated (i5-3210M); not A because each configuration ran once, ccache is used when installed and the compiler version is not stated. Results are mixed.

corrections.claimed_speedup: Independent (j-jorge/unity-build, i5-3210M, Debug default, batch size 65536, make -j nproc): incremental rebuild with about 10% of files modified, tweenerspp 18.12 s to 7.17 s (about 2.53x) and iscool-core 154.03 s to 70.37 s (about 2.19x), but weak-function 3.51 s to 3.97 s (slower); in the Release plot (read by eye) unity is slower for iscool::core below about 20 modified files. First-party (snippet only): CMake MR 3611 reports SpeedCrunch medians with batch size 5 of MinGW 25.215 s to 17.495 s (30.61% time saved, about 1.44x) and MSVC 23.526 s to 12.097 s (48.58%; the stated 48.52% does not match); the Qt blog's 29.33/53.50/23.61% figures were not found again on the second pass.
corrections.hardware: Independent run: Intel Core i5-3210M. First-party SpeedCrunch runs: Windows 10 with an AMD Ryzen CPU (model not shown).
corrections.compiler_and_flags: Independent run: compiler and version not stated, CMake Debug by default, CMAKE_UNITY_BUILD with batch size 65536, make -j$(nproc), ccache on when installed. First-party: MinGW GCC 8.1.0, Visual C++ 2017, Clang-cl 8.0.0, Release, CMake -DCMAKE_UNITY_BUILD=ON.
corrections.caveats: Enricher: BATCH mode cuts the source list into fixed-size chunks in order, so adding or removing one source reshuffles every later batch and defeats incremental reuse. One run per configuration in the independent scripts; ccache may mask compile time. www.qt.io and gitlab.kitware.com were unreachable, so the first-party numbers rest on search snippets.
